goals: Verify that the wood processing machine powers on and accepts cutting thickness configuration correctly
Verify that the machine detects loaded wood and processes it to the specified thickness
activities: Given machine is off; press power button; verify machine turns on and indicator light is green
Given machine is on and showing default thickness; set cutting thickness to 2 inches
Verify machine displays "2 inches" and blade adjusts to 2 inches
Given machine is on and ready with processing mode selected; load a wood piece onto the machine feeder
Verify machine detects wood and displays "Wood detected"
Given wood is loaded and desired thickness is set; press "Start Processing"
Verify machine processes wood and wood comes out at the specified thickness
